question: Which SKUs or categories are spiking or dropping unusually?

tool_calls.query:
SELECT
  p.category,
  p.subcategory,
  p.name,
  DATE(t.txn_ts) as date,
  SUM(i.qty) as total_units,
  SUM(i.line_total) as total_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) as num_txns
FROM tenant_transactions t
JOIN tenant_transaction_items i ON t.txn_id = i.txn_id
JOIN tenant_products p ON i.sku = p.sku
WHERE t.merchant_id = 'KRG'
  AND DATE(t.txn_ts) >= DATE('2026-04-01')
GROUP BY p.category, p.subcategory, p.name, DATE(t.txn_ts)
ORDER BY date DESC, total_units DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  p.category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= DATE('2026-05-23') THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) as recent_units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= DATE('2026-05-16') AND DATE(t.txn_ts) < DATE('2026-05-23') THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) as prior_units,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= DATE('2026-05-23') THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= DATE('2026-05-16') AND DATE(t.txn_ts) < DATE('2026-05-23') THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= DATE('2026-05-16') AND DATE(t.txn_ts) < DATE('2026-05-23') THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) as pct_change
FROM tenant_transactions t
JOIN tenant_transaction_items i ON t.txn_id = i.txn_id
JOIN tenant_products p ON i.sku = p.sku
WHERE t.merchant_id = 'KRG'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY ABS(pct_change) DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  p.name,
  p.category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= DATE('2026-05-23') THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) as recent_units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= DATE('2026-05-16') AND DATE(t.txn_ts) < DATE('2026-05-23') THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) as prior_units
FROM tenant_transactions t
JOIN tenant_transaction_items i ON t.txn_id = i.txn_id
JOIN tenant_products p ON i.sku = p.sku
WHERE t.merchant_id = 'KRG'
GROUP BY p.name, p.category
ORDER BY recent_units DESC
LIMIT 50
